notifications.title: No data audit ran on 23 Oct, so the auditor skipped the data check
notifications.detail: The data-audit cron was moved to 08:23 UTC (13:53 IST) at 10:18 UTC on 23 Oct, after that day's slot, so the newest metrics/data-audit.json is from 22 Oct 17:57 UTC. The workflow is not failing. The new time should give tomorrow's auditor a fresh file. The 22 Oct file has five warnings: v-20261022-02 private on YouTube, v-20261022-03 unknown to YouTube, v-20261022-01 178 vs 120 views, and L-20261019-02 and L-20261018-01 unlisted on YouTube while published here.
notifications.fix:
1. Nothing needed if tomorrow's audit lands before 23:00 IST.
2. For a fresh check tonight: GitHub → Actions → Data audit → Run workflow.
3. Check v-20261022-03's YouTube link on its video page (YouTube doesn't know that id), and whether v-20261022-02 and the two long videos are meant to be private or unlisted.

notifications.title: An agent branch was blocked by a hung CI runner, not by a failing test
notifications.detail: agent/auditor/2026-10-23 was logged 'tests or build failed', but its Python step was cancelled after 40 minutes with no output during the silent apt/pip install (job 119987869699). The same commit passes locally in 19 s. Tonight's branch re-ships its fixes.
notifications.fix: 1. Nothing required. 2. Optional: in .github/workflows/agent-merge.yml give the Python step a timeout-minutes (e.g. 15) and drop the -qq on apt-get, so a hang shows where it stopped and fails fast.
